paragraph: When Rob Adams was eleven years old, he made a promise to his mother. That childhood vow led him to start an organization called Thanksgiving Heroes. Now, the group works to bring holiday meals to people across the country. This year, the effort will provide food for 3,600 families in Utah. Rob grew up as the oldest of six children in South Texas.
